visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black cap and white T-shirt stands in a professional kitchen, holding a smartphone. He looks directly at the camera with an expressive face, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. The background features metallic shelving, cooking pots, and soft studio lighting. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor setting with a red temple in the background. The man, now in a white shirt, walks toward a grassy area. Another cut shows him dressed in yellow Shaolin robes, holding a folding chair and striking a person on the ground. (3) Close-up shots of a smartphone interface showing grocery items. A red clock shows the hand moving to 12. The man reappears in the kitchen with styled white hair, wearing a white chef's coat, looking determined at the camera. (4) A rapid sequence of cooking actions: dicing white onions on a wooden board, dropping pasta into boiling water, and searing a large steak with intense flames rising from the pan. Close-up shots highlight the textures of the meat and the simmering sauce. (5) The man stands behind a kitchen counter with the prepared steak dish. He speaks to the camera while digital app interfaces showing Costco products are overlaid. He sips from a mug and continues explaining with energetic hand gestures.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks Mandarin with high arousal and a friendly, energetic tone. Background music is an upbeat electronic track with a steady 4/4 tempo. The voice is clear, projected, and centered in the mix. (2) A loud 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. Percussive impact thud sounds occur repeatedly, mimicking a stylized fight scene. The male voice becomes more dramatic and exaggerated, shifting pitch dynamically. Ambient outdoor noise is minimal under the music. (3) A high-pitched 'ding' bell sound effect transitions back to the kitchen. The music continues with a rhythmic beat. A faint ticking sound is heard briefly. The vocal delivery becomes slightly more narrative and professional. (4) Sounds of food preparation are dominant: the rhythmic chopping of vegetables, the bubbling of boiling water, and a loud, sustained sizzling sound as meat hits a hot pan. Metal utensils clink against metal surfaces. (5) The male voice maintains a consistent conversational pace, explaining promotional details. The background music remains continuous and upbeat. A soft sipping sound occurs. Digital 'blip' sounds accompany the appearance of various text and app interface overlays.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Challenge -> Training (Parody) -> Execution -> Service Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a creative advertisement for Uber Eats and Costco services. It uses a parody of the classic movie 'The God of Cookery' to entertain viewers while demonstrating the convenience of ordering high-quality grocery items from Costco via Uber Eats to create restaurant-level dishes at home.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the Uber Eats app interface, use of specific promo codes, and verbal promotion of Costco products and Uber One membership.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines humor, pop culture parody, and high-production-value cooking visuals to drive engagement for a food delivery service.
